entry.label: Variety amplification
entry.description: Amplification expands what a system can notice or do through capability, discretion, tools, coordination, networks and access to resources.
entry.canonical_definition: A deliberate increase in effective sensing or response variety available to a regulator, channel or operational unit.

profile.title: Variety amplification
profile.canonical_definition: A deliberate increase in effective sensing or response variety available to a regulator, channel or operational unit.
profile.summary: Amplification expands what a system can notice or do through capability, discretion, tools, coordination, networks and access to resources.
profile.why_it_matters: When the environment cannot responsibly be simplified, the system must improve its repertoire. Giving people more cases without more authority or capability is workload amplification, not regulatory amplification.
practice_connections: pair discretion with information and resources
test whether amplified responses affect the relevant outcome
